name: Meeting - Book Meeting Room

parameters.query: SELECT id FROM mtg_rooms WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND id = $2 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mtg_bookings b WHERE b.room_id = $2 AND b.tenant_id = $1 AND b.status != 'CANCELLED' AND tsrange(b.start_time, b.end_time) && tsrange($3::timestamp, $4::timestamp));
INSERT INTO mtg_bookings (tenant_id, room_id, organizer_id, title, start_time, end_time, attendees, agenda, status, created_at) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8,'CONFIRMED',NOW()) RETURNING id;
